name: Yamanami Keisuke
source:
Secretary-general of the Shinsengumi.
Training schools: Ono-ha Ittō-ryū, Hokushin Ittō-ryū (fully licensed)

"The writers of history are not simply players in the events of the past. They help to determine the future as well."
